prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE full-screen 16:9 cinematic intro background for the 2D game CARD TWO SIGHT, NOT a storyboard, no panels. Distant police red and blue emergency lights enter through narrow slatted windows and stripe the shadowy wall, curtains, and edge of the foreground green felt table. Police cars and people remain outside frame, no visible police or text. Mostly deep black, faint hazy light beams, alternating-color impression captured as a still; ominous escape atmosphere, not a bright neon nightclub. Wide eye-level view toward table and rear door, substantial dark negative space. No UI, no captions, no watermark. This image is the opening dark police-light scene; do not show a money bag yet.
